summary: Admit Ozon Доставка as a separate logistics surface with encrypted Seller API credentials and a bounded warehouse prerequisite probe; delivery operations remain qualification-gated.

impacts.evidence: Ozon Delivery credentials are bound to one tenant-scoped connector account; no caller-supplied tenant override is accepted.
Client IDs and API keys stay behind SecretProvider; warehouse responses and recipient data are not persisted or logged.
No public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is added; the existing connector-account control plane is reused.
No event or canonical envelope is added.
The adapter uses Connector SDK v1 and declares logistics capabilities in the manifest while runtime admission keeps them closed.
No provider-specific table or migration is introduced.
The host performs a fixed TLS-verified warehouse probe and receives credential bytes only inside the callback-scoped secret path.
Rates, shipment, cancellation, labels and tracking are not admitted; future writes require logistics policy and provider qualification.
Health checks reuse connector.account.connection_checked with safe status metadata only.
No remote shipment write or retry path is enabled; future admission must qualify idempotent shipment operations.
Only a fixed outbound Seller API probe is added; no arbitrary callback or unverified tracking webhook is accepted.
Manifest timeout/retry metadata and normalized provider-unavailable health states bound the probe.
The Delivery entry can be disabled through runtime support without a migration or destructive rollback.
Deterministic connector and host transport tests cover credential shape, callback use and bounded request routing; the machine report records SDK checks.
